title: Ramp says it applied to the US OCC for a trust bank charter that, if approved, would allow it to offer fiduciary investment management and digital asset custody (Paige Smith/Bloomberg)
summary: Paige Smith / Bloomberg: Ramp says it applied to the US OCC for a trust bank charter that, if approved, would allow it to offer fiduciary investment management and digital asset custody — Financial technology firm Ramp said it applied with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for a trust bank charter …
